svg.title: Cortex
svg.desc: Cortex: A complete platform for Meta Ray-Ban glasses: an iOS capture app, a FaceTime agent and a web dashboard with 4 modes, 8 skills & 34 tools. A second brain that sees, hears, remembers and even acts: sends email, books events, makes slides.

g.text: A complete platform for Meta Ray-Ban

agent and a web dashboard with 4 modes, 8
